g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: orange = parts added in that step; ghosted = parts still to come
top level; door closes with 3 gap all round
point-to-point check against the wire list (T13)
column plumb 0.5 / 1,000 both ways; shim under the base plate if needed
stage slides free full stroke; plunger drops in each of the 4 holes
H11 M4 x4 3 N·m; press on the inner ring only
spindle turns by hand, no end play felt
H7 x4 M6 8 N·m + thread lock
hub turns free; seal lip oiled with H1 grease
H3 x4 M8 20 N·m; H2 x4 M10 45 N·m
spindle axis to the horseshoe centre ≤ 0.5 (check with a plumb or the tooling tube)
H6 x4 8 N·m; H5 x4 M10 45 N·m; H4 x4 M6 8 N·m; H8 M10 35 N·m
chain sag 4-6 mm; belt 10 mm deflection at 15 N mid-span
no pinch point reachable (ISO 13857); guards need a tool to remove
hopper outlet ferrule on the spindle axis ≤ 1; flap opens the interlock
scraper clears the cone 3 ±1 all round by hand turn
auger hand-tight, it self-tightens in dosing rotation
auger runs true in the tube: 0.75 radial clearance all round (T9)
< 0.1 Ω PE to every metal part (T14)
1. Cabinet 100 on its back on a pallet: screw the 4 feet P1-443 into the weld nuts, set to 60 [2.36] underside to floor. Stand it up, level the top ±0.5 mm/m with the feet.
2. Back panel 105 on the 4 weld studs (spacers + nylocs); mount the DIN parts per E03 and wire per E01/E02 on the bench before fitting if easier.
3. Column 200 on the top: backing plate 107 inside, 4 bolts through top and backing; horseshoe opening to the front (-y).
4. Stage: bushing blocks 703 under the top, rods 702 through, plate 701 on the rods; pin bar 704 on the rod clamp; plunger block 705 and plunger P1-434; sensor bracket 706 + P1-435.

5. Spindle cartridge on the bench: press 6205 #1 on the spindle to the shoulder, inner spacer 310, 6205 #2, DIN 471 Ø25; slide into housing 302 from the top with outer spacer 309 between the bearings, DIN 472 Ø52, cap 308 with the seal.
6. Hub 304: 2 x 6008 on the housing spigot (Loctite 641 in the hub), DIN 471 Ø40 under; bottom seal 25 x 40 x 7 lip down; 30T sprocket plate on the hub.
7. Housing + hub to head plate 301 from below; head plate onto the column cap 203.

8. Gearmotor P1-414 with 15T sprocket under the plate; chain 52 L; tension by the slots. Bridge 307 on its 4 posts; servo P1-413 on the bridge; pulleys 20T / 40T; belt 450-5M-15; tension by the bridge slots.
10. Hopper 400 into the horseshoe from the front, rim on the arm, locate on the 2 pins; lid halves 403/404 and flap 405 with B1 actuator.
11. Agitator 500 up through the hopper onto the hub ferrule, TC clamp P1-445.
12. Tooling J (or S): auger up through the outlet, screw onto the spindle LH M16 x 1.5: turn it clockwise seen from above (against the dosing rotation) to tighten; tube on the outlet TC clamp.
13. HMI A3 and pod operators; foot switch S2 on its cord; cables per the cable schedule; earth bonding.
14. Commission per P1-401-900: rotation, safety function, calibration doses for each container.

1. Tooling change S ↔ J (about 10 min): lock out Q1; hopper empty or scoop the product out; TC clamp off, drop the tube; unscrew the auger (LH thread: turn it the dosing way, counter-clockwise seen from above, to loosen); fit the other set; select the product on the HMI.
2. Stage change: pull the plunger knob, slide the stage to the hole marked for the container (shaker / jar / tub / pouch), release; the HMI asks to confirm the container.

3. Allergen changeover: lock out Q1; hopper off the horseshoe (2 people, about 9 kg empty), agitator off its clamp, tooling off; all product-contact parts to the sink (warm detergent, rinse, sanitise, air dry). Wipe the stage and the cabinet top. ATP swab hopper cone,
4. Do not jet-wash the head or cabinet; the head is IP54 only. Never run the auger dry for more than 5 s (galling in the tube).
5. Re-grease nothing: bearings are sealed for life. Check belt and chain tension monthly (M1).
HARDWARE AND TORQUES (all A2 stainless; full spec on 800)
Hex bolt M12 x 40 A2-70 + 2 washers + nyloc
column base 202 through top 102 and backing 107
Hex bolt M10 x 30 A2-70 + spring washer
Socket cap screw M8 x 25 A2-70
Socket cap screw M6 x 16 A2-70
Hex bolt M10 x 25 A2-70 + washer, into the posts (M10 x 20 deep)
bridge 307 to head plate from below (slots: belt tension)
Hex bolt 1/4-20 x 3/4 in 18-8 + washer + nyloc
gearmotor to head plate (slots: chain tension)
Socket cap screw M6 x 16 A2-70 + thread lock
Hex bolt M10 x 25 A2 + Ø30 washer + thread lock
Retaining rings DIN 471 Ø25 (spindle), DIN 471 Ø40 (spigot), DIN 472 Ø52 (housing)
Countersunk screw M6 x 16 A2 + nyloc
Socket cap screw M4 x 16 A2 (cap 308, 4) / M5 x 10 A2 (sensor bracket 706, 2)
chain guard 306 to plate (4), belt guard 305 to bridge (2)
Socket cap screw M6 x 20 A2
plunger block 705 from under the top
Weld nut M12 A2 (base, 4) + weld stud M6 x 40 A2 with Ø10 x 25 spacer and nyloc (bac
Countersunk screw M10 x 20 A2 + thread lock
